text:
A domestic circuit includes a 30A fuse. This protects the wiring if there is too much current in the
circuit.
In which wire is the 30A fuse positioned, and what does it do when it operates?
position
operation
A
live wire
disconnects the circuit
B
live wire
reduces the current to 30A
C
neutral wire
disconnects the circuit
D
neutral wire
reduces the current to 30A

options.label: B
options.text: live wire reduces the current to 30A

options.label: D
options.text: neutral wire reduces the current to 30A
